verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a card-issuing platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no bulk data export, open-format downloads (CSV/JSON), or offboarding/portability path. Viewing card payments in the Customer Area and the existence of a 'Report' webhook type are adjacent features, not a documented capability to export all data and leave.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
